before.description: The value before, as the `config-integrity` finding shows it

class.description: `process`: a waiver of a process rule (`no-issue`); `detector`: a waiver of a finding

count.description: List entries gained or lost, or baseline findings added

detail.description: Why a configuration or baseline could not be compared

evidence.description: `claimed`: text that asks for an exception; `applied`: a tree change that is one

file.description: Where the exception is: the inline marker's file, the baseline, or `discipline.toml`

gate.description: Gate id, or the configuration table a loosening is under; null for a directive this binary does not map to a gate

hidden.description: The directive was inside an HTML comment

key.description: The configuration option a loosening changed

pr.description: Pull request number, from the subject's `(#N)`

reason.description: The directive's reason text: only under `--reasons`

reason_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the directive's reason, to group reuse without the text

sha.description: Full commit id of the change

tier.description: Who controls the input: `A` git objects on the audited branch, `C` text the change's author wrote

time.description: Commit time, seconds since the Unix epoch

description: The records `discipline audit --json` prints: one per escape hatch a merged change carried, read from git objects only. A record says what was claimed or applied, not whether a check honoured it.

by_gate.description: Gate id (or configuration table) -> record count

changes_with_records.description: Changes that carried at least one record

reference.description: The ref audited, as given or defaulted

schema_version.description: This schema's version: a field added keeps it, one renamed, removed or retyped raises it

title: DisciplineAudit
